comparison.objective: Rinse selected teeth, evacuate water, then return and release both dental tools.
comparison.physical_skill: Coordinated liquid delivery, local suction positioning and dual-tool return; candidate manipulates a loaded rigid screen and discrete rigid media.
comparison.success_condition: Coverage and wet-dwell thresholds, ≥90% liquid recovery, spill/peak-water limits, near-dry mouth, tools returned and released for 1 s. Candidate uses discrete-body mass recovery, washer retention and 3 s support dwell. No material rubric details are missing.
comparison.reason: Both concern recovery and spill avoidance, but liquid irrigation/evacuation tests continuous-fluid tool coordination, not size-selective rigid-body screening.
